meta_description: Done-for-you timesheet chasing and approval tracking for staffing agencies that keep hitting payroll-week chaos.
for_whom: For staffing agencies that place contractors and still chase weekly timesheets by hand
hero_headline: Get contractor timesheets approved before payroll panic starts
hero_subheadline: TimesheetFlow Desk chases missing timesheets, fixes invalid submissions, routes approvals, and gives your team a clean payroll-ready queue before cutoff.
credibility_line: Least-privilege access. Client-approved scripts. Clear boundary: we run the workflow, not your payroll system.
pain_paragraph: A lot of staffing agencies do not have a placement problem. They have a timesheet collection problem in the 24 to 48 hours before payroll cutoff. Contractors forget to submit, client approvers ignore reminders, formats come in wrong, and internal staff lose half a day figuring out what is actually missing. That delay pushes payroll, delays invoices, and makes a growing agency feel more chaotic than it should.
before: Recruiters and ops leads spend Friday afternoon sending the same timesheet reminders again and again
Missing, invalid, or unapproved timesheets are buried across email threads, texts, and spreadsheets
Payroll and invoicing teams do not get a clean exception list until the last minute
Contractors get frustrated when pay is delayed because nobody owned the follow-through
after: Every worker sits in a simple timesheet queue with status, next action, and cutoff risk visible
Missing or invalid submissions get chased on a repeatable cadence instead of ad hoc panic
Client approvals are routed and tracked before they become payroll blockers
Your team gets a concise payroll-ready summary instead of a Friday fire drill
offer_summary: A done-for-you weekly timesheet chase desk for staffing agencies: collect submissions, follow up on missing or invalid timesheets, route approvals, maintain an exception log, and hand payroll or billing a cleaner cutoff queue.
included: Starter scope for one agency workflow with one primary weekly cutoff
Reminder cadence for contractors and client approvers using approved email or text scripts
Invalid-timesheet triage for missing fields, wrong format, and missing approvals
Exception tracker showing who is missing, blocked, corrected, or payroll-ready
Pre-cutoff status summary for payroll and billing teams
Pilot option for one weekly cycle or a small contractor cohort
excluded: Running payroll, issuing payments, or changing your payroll provider setup
Unlimited contractor volume, 24/7 inbox coverage, or custom client portal builds
Resolving pay disputes or making compensation promises on your behalf
Deep ATS, VMS, or ERP implementation work outside the agreed workflow
process: Fit call: confirm contractor count, current submission flow, cutoff timing, and where delays usually happen
Setup: lock reminder scripts, escalation rules, supported systems, and the payroll-ready status format
Run the desk: chase missing submissions, fix invalid entries, route approvals, and keep the exception queue current
Pre-cutoff review: send a concise status summary so your team knows what is clear, blocked, or at risk
Refine: fold recurring client or contractor issues into the playbook so each cycle gets cleaner
pricing_details: Starter covers one weekly cutoff and a capped active contractor count. Growth plans for higher volume, multiple cutoffs, or tighter SLAs start at $1,999/mo.
guarantee_line: If the pilot does not expose clear collection bottlenecks and give you a cleaner cutoff queue than your current process, do not continue.

faq.q: How do you access contractor and client data safely?
faq.a: We work from least-privilege access only, usually a shared inbox, exported roster, or limited seat in your existing system. We do not need bank access, payroll-admin rights, or broad system control, and we can work inside a fixed retention window.

faq.q: What needs to be in place before starting?
faq.a: You need a repeatable weekly timesheet flow, one clear payroll cutoff, and one internal owner for edge-case escalations. Messy current reminders are fine. That is the pain this service is built for.

faq.q: What is included versus not included?
faq.a: Included: reminder cadence, missing-timesheet chase, invalid-entry cleanup, approval routing, and cutoff reporting. Not included: payroll processing, pay-rate decisions, contractor disputes, or full systems implementation.
Usually a few days. We review one live cutoff cycle, lock the status taxonomy and scripts, and start with one contractor cohort or one weekly run before expanding.

faq.q: How long do you retain timesheet data?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for the active workflow and the agreed reporting window. We can delete working files on request after cutoff and archive only the final status output you want to keep.

trust_basics_line: You keep control of payroll policy, pay rates, contractor communications standards, and final approvals. We run the weekly collection workflow so payroll week stops eating your team.
